'''The Called''' are the leaders of [[House Whitehart]] — chosen by calling, not birth. Anyone may hear the voice of the dead and rise, even topple a sitting head of house: ''"the dead spoke to me last night."'' And anyone may ''claim'' to, and no one can prove otherwise. It is the house's glory and its poison.

Whitehart children sit in silence at the griffes until they "hear." Most never hear anything, and live as quiet, second-class stewards. The few who hear — or say they do — are marked early: promise, or danger. Every claimed Called one is tested by the house's Tester (see [[Brother Tomas]]).

The house has an unspoken name for the old pattern: ''the Called serves, wins, and is consumed.''
